_about: Ranks + XP (v1 numbers, design/progression.md). A shift's final score becomes XP; rank comes from all the XP ever earned. xpToNext(rank) = xpBase + xpPerRank × rank. Every shift earns at least max(minXp, minXpPerRank × rank).
_quotaXpMult: F74 — Rank lock (Muzzy 2026-10-29): a rank-up needs the XP goal AND a crack quota met during that rank; until one is met the XP stops at the goal (the meter sits full, extra XP is lost). The shift that meets its quota earns its XP × this (2 = double). The first day and the final shift don't use it.
_activeSlots: F34: how many active upgrades (Cooldown Booster…) can be taken into a shift at once. v1: 1, then 2 with Active Expansion Slot (rank 20) and 3 with the second (rank 38).
_ranks: F78: the top rank, what each rank unlocks and each title's rank are in content/tuning/ladder.json (maxRank; beats nextPiece / swap / upgradesShop; titles).
